boundary_note: This contract identifies integration ownership; it is not a substitute for customer IAM, compliance, or operational controls.

controls.evidence: Gateway/identity integration is not supplied by the repository.
Role policy is declared; enforcement belongs at the service and gateway boundary.
Multi-tenant data partitioning and tenant-scoped keys are not enabled in this research build.
Exports are hash-linked; WORM/retention storage must be bound by deployment.
RTO, RPO, SLO, on-call, and support commitments must be approved per customer.

required_customer_evidence: SSO/OIDC or SAML integration test and break-glass procedure
Tenant-isolation test evidence if multiple customers share a deployment
Immutable retention, access logs, legal hold, backup, and restore evidence
Approved SLO/RTO/RPO, incident response, support, and change-management records
